title: MZ Adding own element to the VisuMZ_1_ElementStatusCore.

posts.author: m0irai
posts.body:
Hello, this is my first post and I'm a little stressed, forgive me. But, to the main problem. I created my own element (Database-->Types-->Elements) and wanted to add it to the ElementStatusCore from Visustella. Everything works fine (I think), except for the icon that doesn't display when you enter the status when testing the game.
See attached images for an explanation (Main issue visible at screen3.png):
Hope some of you have ideas on how to remedy this!

posts.author: m0irai
posts.body:
rpgLord69 said:
Change / to \
Click to expand...
Yup! It worked, thank you! It's hard to notice such details when you're doing 10 things at once
